name: madan-cracked-leetcode
description: Ultimate automated LeetCode solver, scraper and dashboard suite by Madan Prasath

scripts.clean:port: powershell -Command "$p = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess; if ($p) { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Port 3001 freed.' } else { Write-Host 'Port 3001 is already free.' }"
